title: PCA via SVD
hints: Center first: Xc = X - X.mean(0). Then U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False). The rows of Vt are the principal directions, already sorted by singular value.
The variance along component i is S[i]**2 / (N - 1), because Xc.T @ Xc / (N - 1) = V diag(S^2 / (N - 1)) V.T. The ratio divides by the total over all D components, not just the ones you keep.
transform is (X - mean) @ components.T; inverse_transform is Z @ components + mean. With all components kept the round trip is exact because V is orthonormal.
